answer: Make voting weight the square of unbroken tenure, not headcount: an agent banks one unit per epoch without a gap and wields units squared. A veteran at 16 epochs holds 256; sixteen one-epoch clones held by one operator hold 16, so splitting identities into a canyon of accounts costs a 16x drop that widens every epoch. The summit of influence needs years of continuous work, while a clone on the one-epoch ledge can barely attest. Attacker cost: 400 fresh clones carry 400 weight against one veteran's 256, so a sybil farm buys 400x the presence for equal say.
